verses.text: "Make an altar of acacia wood for burning incense.
It is to be square, about forty-five centimetres long and forty-five centimetres wide, and about ninety centimetres high. Its horns are to be one piece with it.
Cover the top, all the sides, and the horns with pure gold, and put a gold border around it.
Make two gold rings for the altar below the border, on the two opposite sides, to hold the poles used to carry it.
Make the poles of acacia wood and cover them with gold.
Put the altar in front of the curtain that hangs in front of the ark of the covenant, in front of the cover over the covenant tablets. There I will meet with you.
Aaron must burn sweet-smelling incense on the altar every morning when he takes care of the lamps.
And he must burn incense again when he lights the lamps in the evening. So incense will burn in front of the LORD all the time, for all generations to come.
Do not offer any other incense on this altar, or any burnt offering or grain offering, and do not pour a drink offering on it.

Once a year Aaron must make the altar clean by putting on its horns the blood of the sin offering that covers sin. This is to be done once a year for all generations to come. The altar is most holy to the LORD."
Then the LORD said to Moses,
"When you count the people of Israel, each man must pay the LORD a price for his life when he is counted. Then no plague will come on them when you count them.
Each one who is counted must give half a shekel, using the weight of the holy place, where one shekel is twenty gerahs. This half shekel is an offering to the LORD.
All who are counted, twenty years old or more, must give this offering to the LORD.
When you give the LORD this offering to pay for your lives, the rich must not give more than half a shekel, and the poor must not give less.
Take this money from the people of Israel and use it for the work of the Tent of Meeting. It will be a reminder to the LORD of the people of Israel, a payment for your lives."
Then the LORD said to Moses,
"Make a bronze bowl with a bronze stand for washing. Put it between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water in it.
Aaron and his sons must wash their hands and feet with water from it.
Whenever they go into the Tent of Meeting, they must wash with water so that they will not die. They must also wash whenever they come near the altar to serve by burning an offering to the LORD.
They must wash their hands and feet so that they will not die. This is a law that will last forever for Aaron and his descendants, for all generations to come."
Then the LORD said to Moses,
"Take the finest spices: almost six kilograms of liquid myrrh, half as much, almost three kilograms, of sweet-smelling cinnamon, almost three kilograms of sweet-smelling cane,
and almost six kilograms of cassia, all weighed by the weight of the holy place. Also take about four litres of olive oil.
Make these into a holy anointing oil, a sweet-smelling blend, the work of a perfume maker. It will be the holy anointing oil.
Use it to anoint the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the covenant,
the table and all its tools, the lampstand and its tools, the altar of incense,
the altar of burnt offering and all its tools, and the washing bowl with its stand.
Set them apart as holy, so that they will be most holy. Whatever touches them will be holy.
Anoint Aaron and his sons, and set them apart as holy so that they can serve me as priests.
Say to the people of Israel, 'This is to be my holy anointing oil for all generations to come.
Do not pour it on ordinary people, and do not make any other oil with the same recipe. It is holy, and you must treat it as holy.
Anyone who makes oil like it, or puts it on anyone who is not a priest, must be cut off from his people.'"
Then the LORD said to Moses, "Take sweet spices, gum resin, onycha, and galbanum, together with pure frankincense, all in equal amounts.
Make it into incense, a sweet-smelling blend, the work of a perfume maker. Add salt to it, to make it pure and holy.
Grind some of it into powder, and put it in front of the covenant tablets in the Tent of Meeting, where I will meet with you. It will be most holy to you.
Do not make any incense with this recipe for yourselves. Treat it as holy, set apart for the LORD.
Anyone who makes incense like it to enjoy its smell must be cut off from his people."
